intro: Pratt McGrubben has heard of hides better still than the last. Up in the north of Feralas, inside Rage Scar Hold, roams another throng of yetis, tougher than those you faced before. Ten of their hides are wanted at Feathermoon Stronghold.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have a lead on an even BETTER source of hides, if that's even possible to believe! In the northern parts of Feralas - deep within Rage Scar Hold - are another throng of yetis. They're much tougher than the ones you dealt with before, so if you're up for a bigger challenge you'd best be on your toes!
I would reward you handsomely for a stack of ten of their hides; bring them to me here, and we'll finish our business.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If these Rage Scar yeti hides are anything like the quality displayed by their Feral Scar counterparts, they could very well be as resilient as thorium!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, excellent! These are going to work out incredibly well - I can already tell that they're going to be much harder when properly cured.
Thanks again for your help friend. Here - please take one of my latest creations.
